question: Does identity-initialized causal three-tap depthwise mixing of each normalized FFN input improve the adopted tokenizer MLA recipe under equal bounded LR tuning?

architecture_review.selected: Causal local mixing before each SwiGLU input projection
architecture_review.rationale: Untested structural family previously deferred only for placement/cache contracts. Recent FFN structure/normalization changes did not improve this backbone; temporal mixing changes receptive field rather than reopening those comparisons.
architecture_review.limitation: A local inductive-bias hypothesis, not evidence that local context is deficient or a Kimi reproduction.

hp_review.candidate: Independent weight decay0.00006 versus0 with equal peak-LR tuning
hp_review.decision: Deferred: valid distinct regularization question, but no new measured decay failure; prioritize the previously queued local-mixing architecture after the completed warmup HP study. Do not reopen warmup.

proposal.placement: u=block FFN RMSNorm(post-attention residual); v[t,c]=a0[c]*u[t,c]+a1[c]*u[t-1,c]+a2[c]*u[t-2,c], zero left padding; existing SwiGLU consumes v.
proposal.initialization: a0=1,a1=a2=0; three 1D channel vectors, no bias/nonlinearity and no RNG draws; shared baseline weights must match exactly.
proposal.parameters: 3*256*4=3072 additional parameters; report total/matrix counts and measured compute, not a parameter-matched claim.
proposal.optimizer: Prospective three vector groups per block in inherited AdamW at base LR and same independent decay; must verify explicit model/optimizer policy and state mapping before use.
proposal.cache: Retain exactly two normalized FFN-input tokens per layer; preserve each stream across chunks, reset to zeros, no future tokens. Four layers add8192 FP32 bytes per batch item beyond existing196608 MLA bytes; measure actual buffers.
proposal.backbone: Adopted D256 MLA score0.5/SwiGLU672/SiLU/blockRMS/no product norm/no warmup/H200
proposal.quality_design: Prospective six equal-LR screens then three fresh pairs; existing strict quality gates, all inference/resource guards. No seeds or training plan frozen.

next_action: Standalone generated forward/all-gradient/causality and unequal-chunk/reset cache checks; then explicit full-model/optimizer/checkpoint/EMA/H200 integration outside frozen namespaces before real worker, seed/capacity census and finite pilots.
